description_en: Queries blacklisted IPs for critical event protection by paged query
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-major-protection-black-ips --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeMajorProtectionBlackIps

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to obtain the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html获取当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the critical event protection template.

This parameter requires the ID of a protection template of the critical event protection type. You can create this type of template only after purchasing the critical event protection upgrade separately
parameters.help_zh:
重保防护模板ID。

本参数需传入重保场景防护类型的防护模板ID。重保场景防护需单独升级购买后才可创建该类型模板
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the critical event protection IP blacklist rule
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address to query. You can set this parameter to perform a fuzzy match against the added IP blacklist
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的IP。您可以设置该参数，模糊查询已添加的IP黑名单
parameters.name: ip_like

parameters.help_en:
The sorting attribute. Results are sorted in descending order by the specified attribute. Valid values:

gmtModified: sorts by modification time.

ip: sorts by IP address.

templateId: sorts by template ID.

id: sorts by primary key
parameters.help_zh:
设置排序属性，支持按照如下属性倒序排列。取值：

gmtModified：表示按照修改时间排序。

ip：表示按照IP排序。

templateId：表示按照模板ID排序。

id：表示按照主键排序
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The page number to return when paging is used. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page when paging is used. Default value: 10, which indicates 10 entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为10，表示每页包含10条结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

IpList.description_en: The list of blacklisted IP addresses

items.description_en: The list of blacklisted IP addresses

ExpiredTime.description_en:
The expiration timestamp, in seconds.
A value of 0 indicates that the entry is permanently effective
ExpiredTime.description_zh:
生效截止时间戳，单位为秒。
取值为0时，表示永久生效

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the blacklisted IP address was last modified

RuleId.description_en: The ID of the critical event protection IP blacklist rule

TemplateId.description_en: The ID of the critical event protection template

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of blacklisted IP addresses
